AGENTS OF D.A.M.S.E.L. - OPERATION REAL ILLUSION
A comic collaboration

Art: Kagekitsu15 (https://www.deviantart.com/kagekitsu15)
Story & Text: napdog86

Agents of D.A.M.S.E.L. is an original spy action series by the author, napdog86, following a league of highly skilled female agents with a statistically improbable tendency to end up captured in the line of duty. The canonical installments are published irregularly on DeviantArt and AO3.

Think Charlie's Angels meets Danger Girl: competent women, genuine peril, dry humor throughout. No grimdark, not overly serious. The comedy emerges from the gap between genuine professional competence and the statistically improbable capture frequency.

Operation: Real Illusion is the first fully illustrated comic in the series.

New to Agents of D.A.M.S.E.L.? Read the series on AO3: https://archiveofourown.org/series/5915881
